source.authorizedTarget: Owned local FolioBuddy dev demo route
source.captureBrowser: Playwright Chromium using installed Google Chrome channel
source.inAppBrowserBlocker: The in-app browser refused localhost, 127.0.0.1, and the exposed Vite network URLs for port 4002.

layout.shell: Fixed top bar. Desktop adds a 256px fixed left rail; tablet and mobile collapse to a top hamburger.
layout.desktop: Main content starts at x=256 with 24px gutters, borderless net-worth hero, two full-width chart cards, four allocation cards in one row, performers in two columns.
layout.tablet: No side rail. Top bar spans viewport. Main content uses 16px gutters, stat row remains horizontal, allocation cards are two columns.
layout.mobile: 390px viewport. Top controls compress, investor selector becomes full-width below the title, stats wrap into two columns, every card stacks vertically.

styles.font: Plus Jakarta Sans with system fallback; tabular figures for numeric values.
styles.radius: 6px cards and controls, matching shadcn rounded-md scale

motion.sourceObserved: Source exposes common transition classes and a page-entry fade-up. Chart and number data are stable after load.
motion.forge: Animated version draws chart paths, fades chart areas, animates donut stroke offsets, lifts cards on entry, and pulses Dev Mode. Reduced-motion media query disables these effects.

gates.motion: Pencil should have no active CSS animations; Forge should expose active animations and settle to the Pencil layout.
